ProceduralFX Studio now runs on Windows.

**Windows (preview)**
- Download **ProceduralFxStudio-windows-x64.zip**, unzip it anywhere, and run **ProceduralFX Studio.exe**. Keep the files in the folder together.
- MoonRay runs in a small Linux container through WSL, so rendering works without installing Linux yourself. The first time, choose **Render → Set Up Rendering on Windows…**. It checks for WSL, then downloads MoonRay (about 1.3 GB, once).
- If WSL isn't installed, the set-up window installs it. Windows asks an administrator to approve that once, and turning on Virtual Machine Platform needs a restart. Downloading and rendering never need administrator rights.
- Rendering on Windows is new: if a render fails, the set-up window and the render log say why.
- Not yet on Windows: binary USD (.usdc), OpenVDB (.vdb) and Alembic (.abc) files.
- Needs Windows 11 with virtualization turned on.

**Also**
- Settings on Windows are kept in `%APPDATA%\ProceduralFX Studio`.
